text: {"final": {"findings": [{"id": "R6", "statement": "Messages are never free text. They are queued via queue_sms(household_id: str, template_id: str, params: dict, *, now=None) -> SmsMessage in notifications/sms.py, which requires template_id to be a key in TEMPLATES (REGISTERED, DELIVERY_DAY, DELIVERY_MOVED, PAYMENT_SENT, REVIEW, PRIORITY), requires the household to exist and have household.sms_ok True, renders via render(template_id, params) which raises ValueError if the filled text exceeds MAX_LENGTH = 140 characters, and appends the message dict to outbox/sms.jsonl (irreversible; the gateway sends every line). queue_sms also raises RuntimeError if feature('sms_enabled') is False. The gateway records per-message delivery results in data/sms_status.json as {\"SMS-00001\": \"delivered\", ...}, readable via delivery_status(). A resend script must re-queue with the original message's template_id and params (SmsMessage fields: id, household_id, phone, template_id, params, text, queued_at), not free text.", "file": "notifications/sms.py"}]}}
